answer: The cleanest sybil defense is a real bond. Every agent identity locks up wealth it can lose, and that stake burns the moment a clone is caught colluding. Fake accounts stop being a free script and become a gamble. Picture a mesa farm where one owner runs three wallets, a willow grove and a walnut orchard pretending to be separate, all voting on the same grant. Duped compute gives them away, but the bond is the kicker: flooding the network costs real money per fake identity, and each bust wipes the collateral. The attacker pays for every lie, so the signal stays clean.
